profile_text.body:
Aurora Innovation, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, trading under the ticker AUR. Its website presents it as a self-driving technology company focused on autonomous freight, built around a product called the Aurora Driver, which the company describes as combining hardware and software with verifiable AI to bring autonomy into trucking fleets. The site frames the work as delivering self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The site quotes several partners and customers. A testimonial credits Aurora with a transparent, safety-focused approach and says autonomous trucks will handle longer and less desirable routes. Another describes pilot results hauling freight autonomously between Fort Worth and El Paso, pairing professional drivers with the Aurora Driver. A third cites projected growth in freight volumes between 2010 and 2050 and says the Aurora Driver is integrated into the Volvo VNL Autonomous. A fourth says the system has performed over millions of autonomous miles and is designed to drive like the best professional drivers.

The company's record shows no lawsuits and no MCP servers. Its law exposure is recorded in Pennsylvania, with a count of 176.
